description: This file defines a React component 'Timeline' for visualizing trace data, including actions, resources, and console messages, with interactive timeline controls.

methods.name: calculateDividerOffsets
methods.description: Calculates positions and times for timeline dividers based on client width and boundaries.

methods.name: timeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a time value to a pixel position within the timeline based on boundaries.

methods.name: positionToTime
methods.description: Converts a pixel position within the timeline to a time value based on boundaries.

methods.name: barTop
methods.description: Determines the vertical position for a timeline bar based on whether it is a resource or action.
